Supervised acceptance pending. Best-effort while charging, from 60 minutes before bedtime to 120 minutes after. Android may delay or miss a start. A fresh 60-second notice lets you cancel. Requires the selected BedJet, an idle unit and a valid night of at least 3 hours. Enable automatic starts again after restoring a backup.
Select a real BedJet before enabling automatic starts.
Notifications are needed so you can cancel an automatic start. Enable notifications in Android settings.

Nocturne reads sleep sessions and their stages only when you open History with this optional feature enabled. Sleep data stays in memory for the overlay; it is not included in Nocturne backups or CSV exports and never changes BedJet control. You can revoke access in Health Connect at any time. Missing records, missing stages or older history do not mean that you were awake. Standard permission may not expose records from more than 30 days before access was first granted.
